program.subject: Weekly mix
program.blurb: A week that visits every shelf: strength, combat, muscles, yoga, a mixed day, HIIT and mobility.
program.about: Seven days, one from each part of the library, then the week starts again. Legs and hips on the strength day, boxing bouts, chest and back, a power yoga flow, a mixed day of lifting, sweating and stretching, a HIIT EMOM and a mobility and balance day. No two neighbouring days load the same muscles. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps.
program.split: Strength / boxing / chest & back / yoga / mixed / HIIT / mobility
